schema.description:
An activity executed by an organization. An activity is further classified by the Inventory Type defining
the activity as a Sink, Source, or a Credit, as well as the scope type, category, and activity type.

Note: Emission Activities can also be grouped into inventories. In this document, however, Inventory
Type is defined by activity, allowing an Emission Inventory to consist of different types; for example, a
collection of Sinks, Sources, and Credits.
schema.title: Emission Activity

emission_inventory_id.description: Foreign Key of the Emission Inventory collection to which the activity belongs.

corresponding_adjustment.description: Optional attribute to identify if an Emission Activity is associated with a Corresponding Adjustment as defined under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) Paris Agreement Article 6; refer to: www.unfccc.int/process-and-meetings/the-paris- agreement/article6.

emission_inventory_type_id.description:
Optional part of a composite key for the Emission Activity Type.
Emission Inventory Type.

emission_component_id.description:
An optional Foreign Key of the Emission Component identifying the type of pollutant or other environmentally significant substance covered by this activity.

Useful when activity directly involves the product of interest; for example, vented or leaked methane or Perfluorocarbons (PFCs).

description.description: A long-form description detailing the purpose of the activity.

product_life_cycle_stage_id.description: Foreign Key of the Product Life Cycle Stage to which this activity is assigned.

product_life_cycle_id.description: Optional part of a composite key of the Product Life Cycle Stage. The Product Life Cycle.

emission_activity_category_id.description: Optional part of a composite key for the Emission Activity Type. The Emission Activity Category.

emission_activity_id.description: The Primary Key of the Emission Activity.

name.description: The name assigned to the activity.

emission_scope_type_id.description:
Optional part of a composite key for the Emission Activity Type.
Emission Scope Type.

organizational_boundary_id.description: Foreign Key of the Organizational Boundary ID.

emission_activity_type_id.description: Foreign Key of the Emission Activity Type.

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
